analysis.reasoning: The shown code gates a nonzero-gradient flag on `p.grad is not None and torch.any(p.grad != 0)`, then calls `ConstraintCheck.true(...)` with the zero-gradient error message. Thus all-zero gradients make the check fail and raise, matching the finding. The paper instead says to reinitialize and continue OUTER, so the abort behavior is an undisclosed discrepancy.
